page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8ia.64xlarge is a high-density GPU server instance powered by 256 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs running on 3.4 GHz AMD EPYC 9T34 processors. The instance is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 6.0 GB RAM per vCPU. Hypervisor operations are managed using KVM.

For workload acceleration, the instance includes four integrated NVIDIA L20 GPUs built on the Ada Lovelace architecture, supplying a total of 192 GB of VRAM across the four accelerators. System connectivity is driven by a 160 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance features no local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data.

The combination of 256 vCPUs, 1536 GB of system RAM, and four NVIDIA L20 accelerators makes this instance suited for large-scale graphics rendering, AI inference, and compute-intensive data science workloads. The reliance on network-attached storage presents an architectural tradeoff, while the high ratio of accelerator memory and network bandwidth provides high resource density for distributed compute operations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8ia.64xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated server instance built for high-performance compute and machine learning workloads. Powered by 256 dedicated vCPUs from 3.4 GHz AMD EPYC 9T34 processors and 1536.0 GB of system memory, it features four NVIDIA L20 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering 192 GB of total GPU VRAM. The system provides a 160 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, supporting high-throughput interconnectivity for distributed data processing. It lacks local disk storage, necessitating network-attached storage volumes for data persistence. This hardware configuration provides significant compute density and accelerator memory, making it appropriate for large-scale AI inference, data science workflows, graphics rendering, and heavy parallel execution tasks.
